summary: Great Western Trail has you driving cattle herds along a shared trail, buying stronger cows and buildings to build an efficient deck-and-route engine over repeated trips to Kansas City. It's a long, cerebral engine-builder where the trail itself creates most of the friction with opponents.
praised: high replayability from the modular board
rewarding sense of building an efficient machine
criticised: long playtime with real downtime, especially at 4 players
analysis paralysis from the sheer number of options

interaction.detail: Players share one trail and race for limited building spots, station placements, and staff hires, so positioning and timing matter a great deal. Each player otherwise develops a private deck, herd, and player board largely independent of others.

subsystems: Cattle drive & delivery to Kansas City
sources: cattle delivered value at Kansas City
scoring.how_you_win: Deliver valuable cattle herds to Kansas City repeatedly while building your own trail buildings and railroad; when the end trigger fires (final delivery lap / supply exhaustion), whoever summed the most points across all sources wins.
